findings.headline: Move this JSX type import off solid-js.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 no longer exports the JSX namespace or the JSXElement alias from solid-js; renderer packages own JSX types, and web projects import JSX from @solidjs/web.
findings.guidance: Move this specifier to a separate import type { JSX } from "@solidjs/web" statement (or set jsxImportSource to @solidjs/web and use the global JSX namespace), leaving every other solid-js binding in place. Also set compilerOptions.jsxImportSource to @solidjs/web in tsconfig.json, which this analyzer does not scan.

findings.headline: Move this JSXElement type import off solid-js.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 no longer exports the JSX namespace or the JSXElement alias from solid-js; renderer packages own JSX types, and web projects import JSX from @solidjs/web.
findings.guidance: Replace JSXElement with JSX.Element from @solidjs/web, or with Element from solid-js for renderer-neutral component code. Also set compilerOptions.jsxImportSource to @solidjs/web in tsconfig.json, which this analyzer does not scan.

findings.headline: Point this @jsxImportSource pragma at the renderer package.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 does not ship jsx-runtime type entries from solid-js; web JSX types come from @solidjs/web (hyperscript from @solidjs/h).
findings.guidance: Change the pragma to @jsxImportSource @solidjs/web for web components, and mirror the change in tsconfig.json's compilerOptions.jsxImportSource, which this analyzer does not scan.
